title: Bottom-up table — rod cutting (the take branch reads its own row)
code: def rod_cutting(lengths: list[int], prices: list[int], n: int) -> int:
pieces = list(zip(lengths, prices, strict=True))  # (length, price) per row
rod = range(n + 1)  # one column per rod length 0..n
for i, (size, price) in enumerate(pieces, start=1):
take = dp[i][r - size] + price if size <= r else 0
